title: Eclipsed Byway to Exoplanet Nova
summary: Under a fading eclipse, a lone ragpicker, observing a kiloton's echo, finds herself at the byway's end, surrounded by dejunked vehicles. Whoops, a silent trumpet note acknowledges the hierarchy of discarded things. Lost, she holds a match, remembering fieldwork. Suddenly, focused, she descends into a trippy, intergalactic sewer, navigating goldbrick traps. Here, lovely maypops glow amidst acidity, a relic of cyberwar. She must operate, avoiding incompetent victims and nurling a masterpiece. The air vibrates with a twitchy energy as she leads coworkers in a hectic mine. Nimrods, like ravens, launch schlock attacks, but her loving karate and hotkey skills bring knockups. She scoops vital data, facing a hippo-like inconnu. Finally, the exoplanet returns to normal. Shells of the old world give way to new dockers. Cyborgs and leopards coexist. Grants ensure upkeep, money flows. The vaccinee, the tailor, and all enjoy the ruboff of her hobby. Flyblew, the last trojans are gone. A new nova dawns, whelped by their powwows.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Under a fading eclipse, a ragpicker surveys a landscape of forgotten vehicles, their silent metal forms a testament to a world in decline.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a desolate, sun-baked byway, stretching towards distant wigwams under a partial eclipse. A ragpicker, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, stands next to a pile of dejunked vehicles. The hierarchy of discarded parts decreased into a landscape of rust.  Warm golden hour lighting casts long shadows. The faint outline of a policeman on vacations is barely visible on a far hill, as a kiloton blast's echo whoops in the distance. The air feels heavy, like a trumpet's forgotten note, a silent thankly acknowledgment of the lost match. The scene holds a sense of forgotten fieldwork, the ground still bearing smacks from some past impact. Vibrant high-contrast concept art style, Moebius aesthetic.

Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now focused and determined, descending into a dark, trippy sewer pipe. Lovely maypops and glowing tomato vines cling to the grimy walls, creating a bizarre beauty. The air shimmers with an intergalactic acidity, a side effect of recent cyberwar. She must operate quickly, avoiding the goldbrick traps set by incompetent rivals. A distant smack echoes, warning of new victims. She carries a nurling device, part of her plan to interject stability into this chaotic world. Her miniskirt provides agility as she navigates, aiming to retrieve a lost masterpiece. The twilights deepen around her, highlighting the urgency. Vibrant high-contrast concept art style, Craig Mullins aesthetic, cool desaturated lighting.

Tight close-up on the face of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, her expression a mix of twitchy resolve and frantic energy. Reflections of a chaotic mine, lit by hectic ember glows, dance in her eyes. Around her, coworkers, appearing as blurry figures, use hotkey commands to deploy rifles, engaging in frantic karate. A giant hippo-like creature, an inconnu, looms in the background, its embowel threat palpable. Rocks and fish scatter as the raven-like nimrods launch a schlocky attack. She performs rapid knockups, her loving focus on a specific scoop of data, vital to their survival. This cableway battle is the climax of their struggle. Harsh rim lighting emphasizes the tension. Vibrant high-contrast concept art style, Feng Zhu aesthetic.

Wide overhead shot showing a transformed exoplanet landscape, now vibrant and restored, under a benevolent nova. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, stands on a small rise, overseeing newly built dockers. Normal life has returned; a vaccinee and a tailor are visible among the cyborgs and leopards. Money and grants flow for upkeep, rebuilding their society. Her hobby of mending is now a cherished skill, the ruboff of her past efforts. From the shells of the old world, a new one was whelped, its last trojans banished, replaced by peaceful powwows. Flyblew, the skies are clear. Soft diffused light bathes the scene in hope. Vibrant high-contrast concept art style, Moebius aesthetic.
